name: Get All Active EcodeWise Bonus Provisioning Policy Mappings
description: Test case for retrieving all active EcodeWise Bonus Provisioning Policy Mappings with employee full names
notes: This endpoint returns all mappings where IsActive = true and IsDeleted = false. It includes employee full names by joining with tblEmployee table based on Ecode. Uses AsNoTracking() and AsQueryable() for performance.
